patch.value: Require explicit delivery attribution before merged-PR closeout

pm-ado issue 33 shows that PR 16 only reported the statement-coverage gap, yet closeout selected it before delivery PR 19 because the item was in progress and its canonical link appeared in the body. Require explicit delivery evidence and report ambiguous candidates without closing.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Root cause confirmed: in_progress bypasses delivery declarations, and ascending PR selection chooses the earlier gap-reporting PR. https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/issues/33 compares https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/pull/16 with https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/pull/19. Neither body declares closure, so both must be reported without closing unless a canonical item-to-PR link supplies delivery evidence. A separate fix/closeout-explicit-delivery PR will retain all prior history.

The real bodies contain only mentions; both are now refused until delivery is explicitly linked. Updated previous positive fixtures to declare delivery instead of relying on status.
